none: PAS FindID 960804: Early Medieval DSpindle Whorl with Runic Inscription
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Lead spindle whorl. Cast cylindrical whorl with a sunken upper surface and a central moulded aperture of diameter 10.3mm, probably Walton Rogers form B. The markedly concave upper surface bears a series of straight and intersecting lines, here interpreted as a runic inscription. Patinated. The size of aperture would admit an Anglo-Scandinavian date while the mass might suggest a primary function…
